name: ShadowFence
description: Check for image reuse and identifying text across your identities. Local, encrypted, and offline.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
